record.oneLiner: A small, sickle-clawed dromaeosaur of Late Cretaceous North America.
record.description: Saurornitholestes was a small, bipedal, meat-eating dromaeosaurid from the Late Cretaceous of Canada and the United States, equipped with a sickle-shaped claw on each foot. It is one of the more common small theropods of the Dinosaur Park Formation.

notableFacts.text: Bore a sickle-shaped killing claw on each foot.
First specimen found by amateur paleontologist Irene Vanderloh in 1974.
